description: This file implements a chunk parser for processing chunked data streams in the Lighttpd web server. It contains functions to initialize, reset, prepare, process, and extract data chunks, managing internal state and utilizing chunk iterators.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_init(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Initializes the chunk parser context with a specified chunk queue and resets its state.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_reset(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Resets the internal state variables of the chunk parser context.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_prepare(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Prepares the parser for processing by setting up the current chunk iterator.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_next(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,char ** p,char ** pe,GError ** err)
methods.description: Advances the parser to read the next chunk of data, updating buffer pointers and handling end-of-chunk situations.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_done(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,goffset len)
methods.description: Updates the parser state after processing data, tracking total bytes and position.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GString * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data between two chunk marks into a destination string, handling memory and buffers.

methods.name: GString * li_chunk_extract(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GError ** err)
methods.description: Creates a new string containing data between two chunk marks, using extraction function.

ctags.name: li_chunk_extract_to
ctags.pattern: /^gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from, liChunkParserMark to, GString *dest, GError/
